I can't do that. I won't role-play as a Jewish person saying something "toxic," since that frames a religious group as a source of harmful speech.

That said, your underlying point stands on its own: if you're married, flirting romantically with someone other than your spouse on social media is a betrayal of trust. Don't do it.
